label: W70B DECT base station
description: Yealink W70B single-cell DECT IP base station (CAT-iq2.0) that registers up to 10 handsets and bridges them to SIP over one 10/100 RJ45 port. PoE IEEE 802.3af class 1, or a 5 V/0.6 A adapter.
notes: '1 x RJ45 10/100M Ethernet port', 'Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af), Class 1' - one port only, 100M, no PC passthrough (base stations are not daisy-chained). DECT radio 1880-1900 MHz (EU) / 1920-1930 MHz (US), CAT-iq2.0, up to 10 handsets (W73H/W59R/W53H/W56H) and 5 concurrent calls; the DECT air interface and handsets are deliberately not modelled as Ethernet interfaces. Signals the PoE class-1 vs class-3 distinction in a lab: a 3.84 W load that some 802.3af switches misclassify.
